_comment: The county (apskritis) of every single-mandate constituency name (issue #217), for the dashboard's grouped filter. Derived by scripts/build_constituency_counties.py, not by reading the names: VRK's own precinct list for each Seimas election, 1996-2024 (`sources`; published at https://www.vrk.lt/lt/rinkimu-apygardu-ir-apylinkiu-sarasas-ankstesniuose-rinkimuose), gives every precinct's district and municipality, and scraper/municipalities.json (#213) gives each municipality's county. `counties` is the union over every map the name was used in, in the registry's population order -- a name is not a boundary, and a district that touched two counties is listed under both; `maps` is the evidence, the municipalities and their precinct counts per general election (by-elections ran on their term's map). A name reused for a different place -- two consecutive maps of it sharing no municipality, a pre-2000 body counting as the bodies it became (scraper/municipalities.json `successors`) -- is split into eras at that boundary (issue #219), one entry each, labelled '<name> (iki <last year>)' and '<name> (nuo <first year>)' and carrying `name`; `eras` lists them per name. Dainavos is the one such name: a Kaunas city district through 2016, the Alytaus r., Prienų r. and Birštonas district from 2020. Names whose counties differ between maps without a split are listed in `changedBetweenMaps`. Two precinct-list entries are read explicitly (the script's DISTRICT_NAMES and MUNICIPALITY_FORMS): 1996's Nr. 67 is 'Prienų' on the cards and 'Prienų–Birštono' in the list, and the 1996/2000 'Kupiškio rajonas' and 2004 bare 'Širvintų' are Kupiškis and Širvintai district. A name with an empty `counties` list has a `note` saying why; the filter groups it apart. `groups` are the filter groups the name is listed in, decided per map (`placedBy`): a map whose precincts are mostly (a strict majority) in one of the five big cities' municipalities (`cities`) places the name in that city's group, which the filter shows just ahead of the city's county group; any other map places it under every county its precincts touch. The name is listed under the union, one option per group. `placementDiffersBetweenMaps` lists the entries whose maps disagree -- Pajūrio, a Klaipėda city majority in 1996 and from 2016 and a minority in 2000-2012, is in both Klaipėdos miestas and Klaipėdos apskritis.

Pasaulio lietuvių.note: the district of voters abroad (2020 and 2024, Nr. 72): no precinct lies in Lithuania
